async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Try to find a 'Members' link on the current page
    members_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Members", exact=False)
    if await members_link.count() > 0:
        await members_link.first.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    else:
        # If no 'Members' link is found, navigate directly to the members page URL
        await page.goto("/byteblaze/millennials-to-snake-people/-/project_members")
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 2: Add users 'yjlou' and 'a11yproject' as reporters
    users = ['yjlou', 'a11yproject']
    for user in users:
        # Find the input field for adding members (common name patterns)
        add_member_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Add member", exact=False)
        if await add_member_input.count() == 0:
            add_member_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="GitLab member or Email address", exact=False)
        await add_member_input.fill(user)
        
        # Find the role dropdown and select 'Reporter'
        role_dropdown = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Role", exact=False)
        if await role_dropdown.count() == 0:
            role_dropdown = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Choose a role", exact=False)
        await role_dropdown.select_option("Reporter")
        
        # Find the add button and click
        add_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Add", exact=False)
        if await add_button.count() == 0:
            add_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Add member", exact=False)
        await add_button.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    return "Users added successfully."
